intro: Roasted and bagged on-site. No secret process — just honest coffee.

items.name: Espresso
items.note: Single shot. Double if you ask like you mean it.

items.name: Americano
items.note: Hot water pretending to be fancy. Still good.

items.name: Cortado
items.note: The size that makes sense. We don't know why this isn't standard everywhere.

items.name: Latte
items.note: Whole milk default. Oat on request — no lecture attached.

items.name: House Drip
items.note: Refills before 10am. After that, you're buying friendship.

items.name: Pour-Over
items.note: Single origin rotates weekly. Ask what's on.

items.name: Cold Brew
items.note: Steeped overnight. Strong enough to notice, smooth enough to finish.

items.name: Hot Chocolate
items.note: Real cocoa. One size. No whipped cream tower.

items.name: Steamer
items.note: Steamed milk, honey optional. For kids and honest adults.
